Chapter 244 - 244 Looks Like They Should Be Grateful To Me?

Chapter 244 - 244 Looks Like They Should Be Grateful to Me?

244 Looks Like They Should Be Grateful to Me?

In the past, when Lin Fan was still an ordinary employee in the company, he would lie on the bed as soon as he got off work. He did not want to move at all.

Even though he had been in Jiangbei for a few years, he had never visited Jiangbei properly.

However, when he drove through DiDi today, he felt a different kind of beauty in Jiangbei.

The spacious and clean road, the neon shops, and the pedestrians who were laughing…

Lin Fan’s face was filled with ease and satisfaction.

At this moment, it would be more accurate to say that he was on a road trip in Jiangbei rather than driving through DiDi to complete a mission.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone vibrated slightly and another order appeared.

He turned the steering wheel and went straight to the location.

Two young people who looked like students got in.

“Jiangbei University of Arts and Science. Thank you,” the boy said.

Then, he whispered, “There are still ten minutes before the dormitory door closes. I’m afraid we won’t be able to make it in time”

The girl seemed to be a little flustered. “Then what should we do?”

“Did you bring your ID card?”

The girl nodded lightly.

The boy said, “Then If it really doesn’t work, we’ll stay outside today.”

The girl did not answer and just lowered her head silently.

At this moment, Lin Fan, who had been silent all this while, said, “Ten minutes? Don’t worry, I’ll definitely drop you off before then!”

He first looked at the map, then stepped on the accelerator and turned the steering wheel. He sped through the shortcuts.

In just seven minutes, Lin Fan arrived at the dorm entrance of Jiangbei University of Arts and Science.

Seeing this

The boy and girl got out of the car with blank expressions.

“There are still three minutes.” Lin Fan shouted, “Quickly go back to the dormitory!”

After saying this, he stepped on the accelerator and sped away.

Lin Fan held the steering wheel with one hand and rubbed his nose with the other. He smiled and said, “They made it back to the dorm in time. Theyshould be very grateful to me now, right?”

Then, he casually looked at the mission system.

[Mission: Complete five special orders. Reward: Five golden packets. [Progress: 4/5]

Seeing this

Lin Fan’s face revealed a look of surprise, “Another special order? It seems like they’re really grateful to me!”

Lin Fan looked at the gradually empty street. He took a turn at the intersection in front of him. After a while, he arrived in front of a door.

After the doorbell rang, Hu Tian slowly opened the door.

This was the first time Lin Fan had seen her since the spring festival.

Compared to before the spring festival, Hu Tian looked fairer now. Her skin was fairer, and her figure was more voluptuous.

At this moment, Hu Tian seemed to have just taken a shower. Her hair was still a little wet, and she was wearing a V-neck thin shirt Lin Fan was stunned.

Hu Tian seemed to have noticed Lin Fan’s gaze as well. She smiled and said, “Why are you standing there like a fool? Why aren’t you coming in?”

Lin Fan finally reacted and walked in.

Creak!

As soon as the door closed, the two of them were attracted to each other like magnets.

o(*)

(*3)(*)

…

Absence made the heart grow fonder.

…

The next day.

When Lin Fan woke up, he could smell the fragrance from outside.

He slowly got up. After washing up, the dining table was already filled with noodles, dumplings, milk, eggs, and other rich breakfast items.

“You should be hungry, right?” Hu Tian smiled. “Hurry up and eat something.”

Lin Fan said, “I am a little hungry.”

After saying that, he picked up the noodles and stuffed them into his mouth.

“Yes! Delicious!” Lin Fan praised.

“If it’s delicious, eat more,” Hu Tian said happily. “By the way, did you take a few days off?”

“Yeah, I’m driving through the DiDi app to experience life,” Lin Fan said.

“Huh?” Hu Tian was stunned.

One had to know

She knew Lin Fan quite well. He had several luxury cars, received tens of millions in bonuses, and was also the biggest shareholder of Flower Stem.

Did he still need to drive through the DiDi app?

Lin Fan smiled. “It’s quite interesting to drive through DiDi. Teacher Tiantian, do you want to experience it?”

Seeing that Lin Fan was not joking, Hu Tian shook her head and said, “I’ve been studying the Hail Conjecture recently. I’m afraid I don’t have the time.”

Suddenly, a crisp voice rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Read ‘Foundation of Modern Algebra’,’Abstract Algebra’, ‘Advanced Algebra’, ‘Algebra Equations’, and ‘Algebra and Geometry’. Reward: The proof process of Hail Conjecture.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his face turned weird.

This was Did he trigger another mission?

The Hail Conjecture was an unsolved mathematical problem. He only needed to read five books to solve it?

Hu Tian seemed to have thought of something and said in an expectant tone, “Are you interested in the Hail Conjecture? Do you want to study it together?”

Lin Fan coughed lightly and said, “For the time being, I’m still more interested in driving through Di Di. In the future Maybe I’ll be interested in the Hail Conjecture.”

“I’ll remember what you said,” Hu Tian said with a smile.

Hu Tian still had classes in the afternoon.

Therefore, after Lin Fan and Hu Tian had lunch, Hu Tian went to Jiangbei University.

Meanwhile, Lin Fan continued to rest for a while before continuing his DiDi Journey.

Today, he was not as lucky as yesterday. After a few consecutive orders, he either sent customers home or sent customers to a hotel It was very dull.

Even at night, Lin Fan still could not receive any special orders.

“Could it be that today is not a suitable day to complete the mission?” Lin Fan muttered.

At this moment, his phone vibrated slightly, and another order appeared.

Lin Fan turned the steering wheel and quickly arrived at the location.

The customer was under a dimly lit tree.

A man with a buzz cut crossed his arms and quickly got into the car.

Not far away, an exquisite-looking female officer in plain clothes happened to see his appearance.

For some reason, the female police officer felt that the man with a buzz cut was somewhat familiar.

Relying on her professional sense, after the man with a buzz cut got into the car, the female officer quickly drove her own private car and quietly followed him.

“Ma Feng Forest Park.” The man with a buzz cut said in a low voice after getting into the car.

Lin Fan did not mind. As usual, he stepped on the accelerator and sped forward.

Ma Feng Forest Park was located in the suburbs of Jiangbei

As they neared their destination, the surroundings were very desolate. There were even some dark lights.

After turning a corner, the man with a buzz cut suddenly grinned and shouted, “Stop the car!”

Lin Fan stepped on the brakes.

“Tsk!”

At this moment, the man suddenly took out a knife and shouted sternly, “Hand over all your money!”

Seeing this

Not only was Lin Fan not afraid, but he even smiled.

Did he encounter a robbery?

This… It should be considered a special order, right?
